headline: 13 teachers' salaries stopped over fake certificates
summary: The government has ordered the recovery of public funds used to pay these MPO-listed teachers.
details: The government has stopped the salaries of 13 teachers who were found to have used fake certificates to obtain Monthly Pay Order (MPO) benefits.
Authorities have also issued a directive to recover the public funds that were paid to these teachers during their tenure.
The action was taken after an investigation revealed that the credentials provided by the teachers were forged.
This move is part of a broader effort to ensure transparency and accountability in the education sector.
caption:
13 teachers caught using fake certificates to get government pay. Now, the government wants its money back.

The government has stopped the salaries of 13 teachers who were found to have used fake certificates to obtain Monthly Pay Order (MPO) benefits.

Authorities have also issued a directive to recover the public funds that were paid to these teachers during their tenure.

The action was taken after an investigation revealed that the credentials provided by the teachers were forged.

This move is part of a broader effort to ensure transparency and accountability in the education sector.

#Bangladesh #Education #Fraud #GovernmentNews #Accountability
